title.narrative: National System for Investment Attraction and Facilitation
Sistema Nacional de Atraccin y Facilitacin de Inversiones

description.narrative: El programa tiene como objetivo general contribuir al aumento de los flujos deinversin privada en Ecuador a travs de la facilitacin de la inversin y el fortalecimiento de las capacidades de atracciny promocin de inversiones. Como objetivos especficos, se propone: (i) contribuir a reducir tiempos, costos y nmero detrmites para el establecimiento de la inversin privada; y (ii) incrementar la efectividad de las acciones de atraccin ypromocin de inversiones por parte del MPCEIP y otras entidades.

The general objective of the program is to contribute to increased private investment flows to Ecuador by facilitating investment andstrengthening investment attraction and promotion capabilities. The specific objectives are: (i) to contribute to reduce times, costs,and the number of steps involved in making a private investment; and (ii) to enhance the effectiveness of actions by the Ministry ofProduction, Foreign Trade, Investment, and Fisheries (MPCEIP) and other entities to attract and promote investments.
